title: MUSLIM KEY YATIMON KI KUFAY MAI SHAHADAT
body:
Muslim key Yatimon ki kufay mai Shahadat Hai
Sar Pito karo Matam yeh Waqt-e-Musibat Hai
Baba Bhi Nahi Sar Par Aur Paas Nahi Maa
Pardes Mai Bachon Par Kya Alamay Gurbath Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Faryad Karay Kissay, Kis say Kehan Dard Apna
Bhukay Hai Akele Hai Aur Pyaas ki Shiddath Hai
Kuch Rehem Nahi Khaya, Haris Ne Sitam Dhaya
Masoom Yatimon Par Ye Kaisi Musibath Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek Bhai Ka Sar Kata Ek Bhai Ko Dikhla Kar
Kya Dard Ka Manzar Hai Kaisi Yeh Kaya Math Hai
Haan Inki Shahadath Bhi Tamheed Hai Karbal Ki
Inhi Bachon ka Matam Bhi Shabir ki Nusrath Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab Pesh Karay Pursa Hum Bibi Rukhaiya ka
Muslim ki Yatimee Par Ye Taza Musibath Hai
Shazadoun ke Rauzon Par Hum Jakay
Har Hal Main Rasheed Toh Bas ek hi Hasrath hai
author: Rasheed Shaheedi
